page_title: TOR 1-1 JUV | Torino v Juventus 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Borna Sosa and he is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino).
90+1' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Valentino Lazaro is replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
90+1' Substitution. Che Adams walks off the pitch and Antonio Sanabria (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Saul Coco (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' A lofted cross from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
85' The shot by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
81' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
79' Total attempts – 10:9.
78' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Timothy Weah (Juventus) replaces Samuel Mbangula.
76' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic stops the ball from going inside the left post.
74' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
72' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Karol Linetty will be replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
72' The game is interrupted as Samuele Ricci (Torino) is flagged offside.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolo Savona can be given a rest.
69' Karol Linetty (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
66' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
64' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
62' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) replaces Yann Karamoh.
62' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Michael Fabbri lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
56' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Thiago Motta, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
56' Paolo Vanoli is stunned as referee Michael Fabbri shows him a RED CARD.
54' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
51' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Saul Coco (Torino) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' 1 - 1 Yann Karamoh looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Nikola Vlasic (Torino), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the left post. The score is 1:1.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Samuele Ricci (Torino) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
45' Torino players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
43' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
40' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
39' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' Yann Karamoh (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
31' Federico Gatti (Juventus) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
26' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
25' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
24' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
19' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Juventus have a corner.
17' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

17' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Torino as they win a corner.

15' Karol Linetty (Torino) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
12' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
12' One of the Torino players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Juventus.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.
7' Nice passing game by Torino. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
2' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
Juventus will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
